header: What Desiderio takes off your estimate
subheadline: One GPL package replaces the template scaffold, the component library and the demo content of a typical relaunch. That saves weeks of development.

items.title: Demo site in one command
items.description: desiderio:styleguide:seed builds a complete demo site. It is safe to rerun and works in workspaces, so you can show a client the same day.

items.title: Quality checked on every change
items.description: An automated template audit checks all 244 elements. It allows no inline styles and no fixed colours.

items.title: PHPStan level 8 + PHPUnit
items.description: PHPStan at level 8 and a PHPUnit suite run against every supported PHP version.

items.title: Fewer tickets for developers
items.description: Backend previews for every element and guided forms let people who don't code publish landing pages on their own.

items.title: Redesigns without a deployment
items.description: Switch between 15 shadcn theme presets and the site changes at once. Each campaign can have its own look.

items.title: 5 icon libraries, one switch
items.description: Swap Lucide for Tabler, HugeIcons, Phosphor or Remix Icon across the site. Stable icon names mean no element content changes.
